modulos.descripcion: Resumen ejecutivo de ventas, ingresos y tendencias del negocio.

kpis.label: Ingresos Totales
kpis.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 0) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Transacciones
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo") AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Unidades Vendidas
kpis.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM("Quantity"), 0) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Clientes Activos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS v FROM online_retail

graficos.sub: Evolución de ingresos a lo largo del tiempo
graficos.sql: SELECT strftime("InvoiceDate", '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS ingresos FROM online_retail GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes
SELECT strftime("InvoiceDate", '%Y-%m') AS mes, SUM("Quantity") AS unidades FROM online_retail GROUP BY mes ORDER BY mes
SELECT "Country", SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS ingresos FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 10

graficos.sub: Participación de cada país en los ingresos totales
graficos.sql: SELECT "Country", SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS ingresos FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 10

graficos.sub: Valor promedio por transacción cada día
graficos.sql: SELECT DATE("InvoiceDate") AS dia, AVG("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS ticket_promedio FROM online_retail GROUP BY dia ORDER BY dia

tablas.sub: Detalle mensual de transacciones, unidades e ingresos
tablas.sql: SELECT strftime("InvoiceDate", '%Y-%m') AS Mes, COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo") AS Transacciones, SUM("Quantity") AS Unidades, ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS Ingresos FROM online_retail GROUP BY Mes ORDER BY Mes DESC

modulos.descripcion: Análisis de productos más vendidos, rentabilidad y rendimiento del catálogo.

kpis.label: Productos Únicos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Description") AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Precio Unitario Promedio
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("UnitPrice"), 2) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Cantidad Promedio por Línea
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG("Quantity"), 1) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Devoluciones
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS v FROM online_retail WHERE "Quantity" < 0

graficos.sql: SELECT "Description", SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS ingresos FROM online_retail WHERE "Quantity" > 0 GROUP BY "Description" ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 15
SELECT "Description", SUM("Quantity") AS unidades FROM online_retail WHERE "Quantity" > 0 GROUP BY "Description" ORDER BY unidades DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT CASE WHEN "UnitPrice" <= 2 THEN '≤ $2' WHEN "UnitPrice" <= 5 THEN '$2 - $5' WHEN "UnitPrice" <= 10 THEN '$5 - $10' WHEN "UnitPrice" <= 20 THEN '$10 - $20' WHEN "UnitPrice" <= 50 THEN '$20 - $50' ELSE '> $50' END AS rango_precio, COUNT(*) AS cantidad FROM online_retail GROUP BY rango_precio ORDER BY MIN("UnitPrice")
SELECT "Description", SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS margen FROM online_retail WHERE "Quantity" > 0 GROUP BY "Description" ORDER BY margen DESC LIMIT 10

tablas.sub: Los productos con mayor rendimiento en ventas
tablas.sql: SELECT "Description" AS Producto, COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo") AS Facturas, SUM("Quantity") AS Unidades_Vendidas, ROUND(AVG("UnitPrice"), 2) AS Precio_Promedio, ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS Ingresos_Totales FROM online_retail WHERE "Quantity" > 0 GROUP BY "Description" ORDER BY Ingresos_Totales DESC

modulos.descripcion: Análisis de comportamiento de clientes, valor y segmentación.

kpis.label: Total Clientes
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Clientes por País (Promedio)
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "Country"), 0), 0) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Ingreso Promedio por Cliente
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID"), 0), 2) AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Facturas por Cliente (Promedio)
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo") AS FLOAT) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID"), 0), 1) AS v FROM online_retail

graficos.sql: SELECT "CustomerID", SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS gasto_total FROM online_retail GROUP BY "CustomerID" ORDER BY gasto_total DESC LIMIT 15

graficos.sub: Distribución geográfica de la base de clientes
graficos.sql: SELECT "Country", COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS clientes FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY clientes DESC LIMIT 15

graficos.sub: Distribución del número de facturas por cliente
graficos.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN num_facturas <= 5 THEN '1-5' WHEN num_facturas <= 20 THEN '6-20' WHEN num_facturas <= 50 THEN '21-50' WHEN num_facturas <= 100 THEN '51-100' ELSE '> 100' END AS rango, COUNT(*) AS clientes FROM (SELECT "CustomerID", COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo") AS num_facturas FROM online_retail GROUP BY "CustomerID") GROUP BY rango ORDER BY MIN(num_facturas)
SELECT "Country", COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS clientes FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY clientes DESC LIMIT 10

tablas.sub: Detalle de los clientes con mayor valor para el negocio
tablas.sql: SELECT "CustomerID" AS Cliente, "Country" AS Pais, COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo") AS Facturas, SUM("Quantity") AS Unidades, ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS Gasto_Total, ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo"), 0), 2) AS Ticket_Promedio FROM online_retail GROUP BY "CustomerID", "Country" ORDER BY Gasto_Total DESC

modulos.descripcion: Análisis geográfico de ventas, mercados y oportunidades regionales.

kpis.label: Países Atendidos
kpis.sql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT "Country") AS v FROM online_retail

kpis.label: Mercado Principal
kpis.sql: SELECT "Country" AS v FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") DESC LIMIT 1

kpis.label: Ingreso Mercado Principal
kpis.sql: SELECT SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") AS v FROM online_retail WHERE "Country" = (SELECT "Country" FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") DESC LIMIT 1)

kpis.label: Ingreso Promedio por País
kpis.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice") / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT "Country"), 0), 2) AS v FROM online_retail

graficos.sub: Ranking de países por ingresos generados
graficos.sql: SELECT "Country", ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS ingresos FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY ingresos DESC
SELECT "Country", SUM("Quantity") AS unidades FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY unidades DESC

graficos.sub: Distribución porcentual de ingresos por país
graficos.sql: SELECT "Country", ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS ingresos FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY ingresos DESC LIMIT 10

graficos.sub: Valor promedio por transacción en cada mercado
graficos.sql: SELECT "Country", ROUND(AVG("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS ticket_promedio FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY ticket_promedio DESC LIMIT 15

tablas.sub: Métricas detalladas de cada mercado internacional
tablas.sql: SELECT "Country" AS Pais, COUNT(DISTINCT "InvoiceNo") AS Facturas, COUNT(DISTINCT "CustomerID") AS Clientes, SUM("Quantity") AS Unidades, ROUND(SUM("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS Ingresos, ROUND(AVG("Quantity" * "UnitPrice"), 2) AS Ticket_Promedio FROM online_retail GROUP BY "Country" ORDER BY Ingresos DESC
